2026-05-05: #99 design pass complete. See docs/design-99-project-resolution-refusal.md.

Decisions locked: D1 refuse (no auto-pin), D2 inline error w/ resolver chain, D3 reads stay silent, D4 telemetry piggyback, D5 break loudly + document. Q1 CLI exit code locked to 1 (matches handleError, no precedent shift).

ARCHITECTURE: single chokepoint in new src/projectResolution.ts → resolveScopeForWrite(scope) throws ProjectResolutionError. 11 write entry points across storage.ts/alias.ts/confirm.ts/store.ts/commands/data-management.ts each gain a one-line guard. findProjectFile() keeps existing return shape; new sibling findProjectFileWithDiagnostic() (Option A) supplies the inline-message data. Cascade fns (removeAliasesForKey/removeConfirmForKey) likely don't need their own guard — verify in implementation.

NEXT SESSION LIKELY PICKS UP: implementation pass on #99. Three open Qs remain (cascade verification, resolver-refactor option A vs B confirmation, MCP error wire format) — all empirically verifiable, not design choices. Suggested first PR: just the new src/projectResolution.ts module + diagnostic refactor + tests for resolveScopeForWrite itself; second PR wires the 11 entry points and updates LLM_INSTRUCTIONS + CHANGELOG.

Issues filed earlier today: #99 (this), #100 (size budget), #101 (write-amp guard), #102 (audit project=. bug), #103 (tier docs). All v1.14.0. Theme E (Guardrails / data hygiene) is the chosen direction; Phase 2 theme pick (~2026-05-14) is effectively pre-decided.

Open commits ahead of origin/main: none after this push. Two earlier pushed: 6b86e61 (Lane 1) + 1f1fea4 (Lane 2). About to push the design doc + this note.
